Tesseract.js 7.0.0 with tesseract.js-core 6.1.2 (SIMD, LSTM only) and the English "best_int" model from
@tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0 (all Apache 2.0, https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js) – reads the card name and the
set code from the camera for the collection scanner. Loaded only when the scanner opens; not precached.
